big_case.notes: Emergency application over a Fourth Circuit mandamus order compelling the FCC to rule on a pending challenge to its Public Notice extending lowest-unit-charge advertising rates to party committees ahead of the November 2026 midterms. Real near-term stakes for party ad buying and a recurring emergency-docket dispute already stayed once, but the question presented is a narrow procedural one (whether a court may compel an agency to decide, not what it decides), and the denial leaves the merits to the agency and ordinary review.
